# IgnittoMedia
> We don't edit videos. We engineer attention.

IgnittoMedia is a high-end video production and creative engineering studio helping founders, creators, B2B SaaS companies, and brands transform raw footage into high-retention, revenue-generating video assets.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- **Short Form Video Editing**: High-retention vertical edits for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. Cold open hooks, dynamic motion typography, fast-pacing, and retention engineering.
- **Long Form Video Editing**: YouTube essays, documentaries, and deep-dive talking head videos with pattern interrupts and storytelling arcs.
- **Commercial Video Production**: Brand narrative spots, product launch videos, and high-converting ad creative.
- **Podcast Video Editing**: Multi-camera switching, audio mastering, dynamic lower thirds, and short clips extraction.
- **Motion Graphics & Animation**: 2D/3D kinetic typography, product mockups, UI animations, and explanatory graphics.
- **Creative Direction**: Visual strategy, thumbnail design, title hooks, and content architecture.

## Performance Highlights & Case Metrics
- 100+ projects delivered
- 20M+ organic views generated
- 96% client retention rate
